2609.17193.title: End-to-End Latency-Minimizing and Load-Balanced Request Scheduling for Edge LLM Inference in Agentic AI Services
2609.17193.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-powered agentic AI services increasingly demand low-latency inference, motivating the deployment of LLMs across distributed edge servers. However, heterogeneous communication and computing capabilities, together with dynamically evolving inference states, make the edge server selection for each incoming request time-varying and tightly coupled across slots. In this paper, we investigate an online request scheduling framework for edge LLM inference that jointly minimizes long-term average end-to-end latency and regulates workload distribution across heterogeneous edge servers. Two main challenges arise in this context. First, conventional latency models cannot accurately capture the fine-grained dynamics of multi-stage LLM execution. Second, the latency consequence of a scheduling decision is observed only after request completion, making immediate decision evaluation difficult. To address these challenges, we develop a cross-slot inference model that captures transmission, prefill, iteration-level decoding, and key-value (KV) cache evolution for each diverse request, and characterize server workload through a KV cache memory-time consumption metric. We propose the LYREO approach that transforms the long-term load-balancing constraint via Lyapunov optimization and employs reward redistribution with sequencebased return prediction to convert delayed outcomes into timely learning signals for earlier decisions. Simulations under various configurations demonstrate that LYREO consistently achieves lower latency and more balanced load distribution than representative learning-based and heuristic baseline schemes.
2609.17193.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）驅動的代理人工智慧服務越來越需要低延遲推斷，這促使LLM在分散的邊緣伺服器上部署。<lb/>然而，異質的通信和計算能力，加上不斷變化的推斷狀態，使得每個進來請求的邊緣伺服器選擇隨時間變化，並在時段之間緊密耦合。<lb/>在本文中，我們研究了一個在線請求調度框架，用於邊緣LLM推斷，該框架共同最小化長期平均端到端延遲並調節異質邊緣伺服器之間的工作負載分配。<lb/>在這個背景下出現了兩個主要挑戰。<lb/>首先，傳統的延遲模型無法準確捕捉多階段LLM執行的細粒度動態。<lb/>其次，調度決策的延遲後果僅在請求完成後才能觀察到，這使得即時決策評估變得困難。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們開發了一個跨時段推斷模型，捕捉每個多樣請求的傳輸、預填充、迭代級解碼和鍵值（KV）快取演變，並通過KV快取記憶時間消耗指標來描述伺服器工作負載。<lb/>我們提出了LYREO方法，通過Lyapunov優化轉化長期負載平衡約束，並採用基於序列的回報預測進行獎勵再分配，將延遲結果轉化為及時的學習信號，以便於更早的決策。<lb/>在各種配置下的模擬顯示，LYREO始終實現了比代表性的基於學習和啟發式基線方案更低的延遲和更平衡的負載分配。
